name: Grow Your Own Golem Kit
description: (Tag:production)(Tag:summon)A beginner-friendly golem-growing kit even a child can use, containing a person-sized pot, watering can, pack of cores, and notebook. Place a core, desired golem materials, and a specification note in the pot, bury it in any dirt in a sunny spot, and water twice morning and night for 7 days before digging up the finished golem. Energy-rich soil speeds the process.
